-- reportcheck/main.go --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
)

type packageInfo struct {
	Path string `json:"path"`
	Standard bool `json:"standard"`
	InstanceState bool `json:"instance_state"`
	HostReachable bool `json:"host_reachable"`
	Classification string `json:"classification"`
}

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	var report struct {
		FormatVersion int `json:"format_version"`
		Programs []struct {
			Name string `json:"name"`
			Packages []string `json:"packages"`
		} `json:"programs"`
		Packages []packageInfo `json:"packages"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &report); err != nil { panic(err) }
	if report.FormatVersion != 1 || len(report.Programs) != 2 { panic("bad report header") }
	packages := make(map[string]packageInfo)
	for _, p := range report.Packages { packages[p.Path] = p }
	base64 := packages["encoding/base64"]
	if !base64.Standard || !base64.InstanceState || !base64.HostReachable || base64.Classification != "selected-standard-probe" { panic("bad base64 classification") }
	base32 := packages["encoding/base32"]
	if !base32.Standard || !base32.InstanceState || !base32.HostReachable || base32.Classification != "selected-standard-probe" { panic("bad base32 classification") }
	shared := packages["example.org/isolatebuildtest/shared"]
	if shared.Standard || !shared.InstanceState || shared.HostReachable || shared.Classification != "reachable-application" { panic("bad shared classification") }
	strconv := packages["strconv"]
	if !strconv.Standard || strconv.InstanceState || strconv.Classification != "unclassified-standard" { panic("bad strconv classification") }
	json := packages["encoding/json"]
	if !json.Standard || json.InstanceState || json.Classification != "unclassified-standard" { panic("bad json classification") }
}
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
	"encoding/base32"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"isolate"
)

func run(name string) {
	program, ok := isolate.LookupProgram(name)
	if !ok {
		panic("missing program " + name)
	}
	instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program, Input: []byte(name)})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := instance.Start(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	select {
	case command := <-instance.Commands():
		fmt.Println(name, string(command.Payload))
		command.Reply([]byte("ok"), nil)
	case <-instance.Done():
		panic("program returned without a command")
	}
	<-instance.Done()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("host base32 before", base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}))
	fmt.Println("host base64 before", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}))
	run("orders")
	run("orders")
	run("billing")
	fmt.Println("host base32 after", base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}))
	fmt.Println("host base64 after", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}))
}
-- host_overlap/main.go --
package main

import (
    "example.org/isolatebuildtest/shared"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
)

func main() {
    fmt.Println("host before", shared.Next())
    program, ok := isolate.LookupProgram("orders")
    if !ok { panic("missing orders") }
    instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program, Input: []byte("orders")})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    if err := instance.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
    command := <-instance.Commands()
    fmt.Println("overlap", string(command.Payload))
    command.Reply([]byte("ok"), nil)
    <-instance.Done()
    fmt.Println("host after", shared.Next())
}
-- orders/isolate.json --
{"name":"orders"}
-- orders/main.go --
package main

import (
	"encoding/base32"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"example.org/isolatebuildtest/shared"
	"isolate"
	"strconv"
)

var counter = 40 + shared.Next()

func init() { println("orders init") }

func main() {
	counter++
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(struct{ Counter int `json:"counter"` }{counter})
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	var decoded struct{ Counter int `json:"counter"` }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &decoded); err != nil || decoded.Counter != counter {
		panic("json round trip did not preserve isolate value")
	}
	input := <-isolate.Inbox()
	shared.CheckPool()
	if got := shared.PeekCounter(0); got != 101 {
		panic("generic read did not use initialized isolate state")
	}
	shared.SetCounter(149)
	(shared.GenericCounter[int]{}).Add(1)
	if got := shared.PeekCounter(1); got != 151 {
		panic("generic write did not use isolate state")
	}
	if got := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}); got != "+w==" {
		panic("base64 state was not freshly initialized")
	}
	if got := base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}); got != "7M======" {
		panic("base32 state was not freshly initialized")
	}
	base32.StdEncoding = base32.HexEncoding
	if got := base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}); got != "VC======" {
		panic("base32 isolate state did not change")
	}
	base64.StdEncoding = base64.URLEncoding
	if got := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb}); got != "-w==" {
		panic("base64 isolate state did not change")
	}
	payload := append([]byte("orders:"), input...)
	payload = append(payload, ':')
	payload = append(payload, strconv.Itoa(counter)...)
	payload = append(payload, ':')
	payload = append(payload, strconv.Itoa(shared.Next())...)
	response, err := isolate.Call(1, payload)
	if err != nil || string(response) != "ok" {
		panic("orders reply")
	}
}

-- billing/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example.org/isolatebuildtest/shared"
	"isolate"
	"strconv"
)

func init() { println("billing init") }

func main() {
	input := <-isolate.Inbox()
	shared.CheckPool()
	payload := append([]byte("billing:"), input...)
	payload = append(payload, ':')
	payload = append(payload, strconv.Itoa(shared.Next())...)
	response, err := isolate.Call(1, payload)
	if err != nil || string(response) != "ok" {
		panic("billing reply")
	}
}
-- shared/state.go --
package shared

import "sync"

var counter = 100
var pool = sync.Pool{New: func() any { return new(int) }}
var poolReused bool

func init() {
	first := pool.Get()
	pool.Put(first)
	poolReused = pool.Get() == first
	println("shared init")
}

func CheckPool() {
	if poolReused { panic("pool reused a value during isolate initialization") }
}

func Next() int {
	counter++
	return counter
}

func SetCounter[T ~int](n T) { counter = int(n) }

func PeekCounter[T ~int](delta T) int { return counter + int(delta) }

type GenericCounter[T ~int] struct{}

func (GenericCounter[T]) Add(n T) { counter += int(n) }
